# Skill names shipped with Cortex Code.
#
# A skill in this repo that reuses one of these names silently shadows the
# bundled skill at runtime, which is hard to diagnose from a session. The
# validator treats a collision as a blocking error.
#
# Refresh by running `/skill list` in a Cortex Code session and recording the
# names grouped under the bundled location. Ordered alphabetically.

agent-optimization
agent-studio
ai-functions-pipeline-builder
build-app

certify-object

intent-driven-governance
introduce-coco-desktop
listing-observability
local-plugin-installer
manage-zerocopy-sapbdc
marketplace-provider
plugin-creator
recommend-object
restricted-session-scope
sar-actions-desktop
search-optimization
share-skill-and-plugin
